# NOW — the Chronicle

*Narrative only, regenerated by the engine from the page's records after every block (`saga.py record`); nothing here is edited by hand. Nothing from the real logs appears on this page except through the Reckoning.*

**BOOK II — THE TEMPERING ROAD · Chapter 7 — The Far Bank · dusk into night on the day of the weir**

- **Where:** The river mill; the mill road at the end of the lamps, the crossed carts drawn up along it.
- **The quest:** *The Road.* North out of Coldmere by the mill tracks on Rae's cart, the quiet road, chosen for his own: keep the company out of the writs' reach and the hunt's. A rider sent to bring the captain of the Ninth in alive, and not told why, has found him anyway, and at the river mill where Rae's salt goes a dozen carts stand drawn up the wrong way at the bridge, everyone looking back.
- **What Darrow is fighting right now:** The mill bridge: carts from the far bank crossing one at a time under the mill's lamps through the night, and at the edge of the field behind them, shapes that have begun to walk out of the trees.
- **Just happened (Between):** *Name the Load.* At the end of the lamps Rae told him that had been a walk, in case he was wondering, and waited for him to come level before she walked back toward the bridge.
- **Earlier today, in order:** *The Right Side of the Bridge* (Scene): At the far edge of the field across the river, shapes stood at the edge of the trees and began, slowly, to walk out; nobody said what they were, and Wren count…
- **With him:** Maelis Vorne (At the bridge, counting how long he stands; since *The Right Side of the Bridge*) · Ser Hollis Garrow (At the bridge, freeing locked carts with a pole and a great deal of language; since *The Right Side of the Bridge*) · Wren Ashdown (At the bridge with the ledger, counting carts and the shapes across the field; since *The Right Side of the Bridge*) · Rae Thorne (Walking back toward the bridge with the lamp, at his pace.) · Ash (Across Darrow's boots at the near end of the bridge; since *The Right Side of the Bridge*)
- **Also here:** Ysra Tal (Got up off the ice on her own, took up her sword, said his message back to him word for word, named him Plainspoken, and rode into the alde…)
- **The tales:** Tale 1 — Where Not to Stand (told in full) · Tale 2 — Road's the Road (told in full) · Tale 3 — Two Boys Holding Horses (1 of 3 told)
- **Against him:** Whatever stands at the edge of the trees across the river, behind the carts.
- **Next:** The night on the bridge, one cart at a time.
- **Open choice:** none.
